notes: 2018_00_link.txt is the Rensselaer Faculty Handbook, approved August 15, 2016; 2018_01_hr_policy_1300_leaves_jan2018.txt is HR Policy Guidelines Section 1300, January 2018; 2018_02_hr_policy_1300_leaves_mar2014.txt is HR Policy Section 1300, March 2014.

Governing document for faculty leave: the Faculty Handbook (approved 2016-08-15; Wayback capture 2018-07-13; no later edition saved), Part 7.4 Parental Leave and Part 3.2.2 Tenure Period. It applies to Tenure Faculty at all locations; Troy is the main campus, Hartford a branch campus.

HR Policy 1300 January 2018 edition (2018_01) is taken as in force on the reference date 2018-02-25 (footer dated January 2018, before the reference date; it adds NY Paid Family Leave effective 2018-01-01). It also mentions a NYC rule effective May 5, 2018 (not a component). The March 2014 edition (2018_02) differs relevantly only in: no NYPFL; medical leave restoration within 10 months instead of 6; 'Parental Leave' has no faculty referral sentence. Provisions coded from 2018_01.

HR Policy 1300 is written mainly for staff (PTO, RTO, short-term disability, NYPFL say 'staff'); the Leave of Absence policy 1300.5 says 'Regular employees' and FMLA 1300.6 'All Employees'. Staff-only provisions are coded with a staff faculty_group (c13, c14, c17, c18, c19); 1300.5 provisions without a staff limit are coded as covering faculty and flagged ambiguous where the text suggests otherwise (c8, c9, c10).

Documents cited but not saved: the Rensselaer Sick Leave and Vacation Leave policies for faculty (Handbook 7.4 'Consult the Division of Human Resources'); The Rensselaer Human Resources Benefits Guide and the formal benefit plan documents (Handbook Part 7); long-term disability plan (named only as 'long term disability award' and 'short-term or long-term disability'; no terms saved, so no LTD component); HR Policy #1400.7 Workers' Compensation Program; HR Policy #900.1 Progressive Discipline; HR Policy #600.6 Religious Accommodation; Policy on Supplemental Pay for Faculty; Policy on Chaired Professor Positions; Faculty Senate Constitution; Intellectual Property and Conflict of Interest policies; Provost's Memorandum on the Academic Calendar; District of Columbia Family and Medical Leave Act; NY Disability Benefits Law s. 205 (duration).

Not components: sabbatical leave (professional development; Handbook 7.4); extension of the Pre-tenure Period for delays in start-up packages (professional circumstance a parent cannot use for a birth); jury duty, bereavement, military, military spouse, bone marrow and blood donation, voting leaves, holidays, consistent attendance (purposes outside a birth or adoption).

Calendar: the Handbook organises the year in Fall and Spring semesters and states an academic year of 'approximately 36 weeks' for appointment and salary purposes (2.3, 2.6.1); no semester length is stated, so calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Chain, birth parent: parental teaching relief one semester at full pay (c1), with FMLA 12 workweeks concurrent from its start (c7) -> optional second semester of teaching relief at half pay (c2, part_time_option). NY DBL (c12) runs with FMLA from week 2 (generic plan, no stated duration). Discretionary: FMLA (c7) -> HR medical leave of absence (c8) to six months from the first day out (leave limit 26 weeks); HR half-time parental leave (c10) also available with FMLA. Tenure clock: one-year extension (c3).

Chain, non-birth parent: parental teaching relief one semester at full pay (c1), with FMLA 12 workweeks concurrent (c7) -> optional second semester of teaching relief at half pay (c2). Discretionary: HR half-time parental leave (c10) also available with FMLA. Tenure clock: one-year extension (c3).

Rule gap reported: the Handbook's parental relief keeps non-teaching duties 'except as entitled under the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA)', and leaves under the policy count toward the FMLA entitlement; the FMLA-entitled part of the full-pay semester (up to 12 workweeks) may therefore be a full paid leave from all duties. Coded as one modified_duties component (teaching relieved, research continuing) with an ambiguous flag; no separate employer_paid_leave component was created.
NY Paid Family Leave (c13, c14) is coded for 'staff employees' as the documents state; whether faculty were covered in 2018 is not stated in the saved documents.
